title: Characterization of myocardial function, structure, and metabolism across the spectrum of cardiac diseases using CMR and MRS – CMR Registry
summary: The purpose of this study is to establish a registry of cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) examinations. Data acquired during clinically indicated CMR examinations will be prospectively collected and analyzed to improve the understanding of the diagnostic and prognostic value of CMR in patients with cardiovascular diseases. In predefined subgroups of participants, the imaging protocol may be extended to include magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) and/or exercise testing using an MRI-compatible bicycle ergometer during the CMR examination, depending on the clinical indication.

interventions.name:
• Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) according to clinical indication
•In defined subgroups: magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS), including proton MRS (¹H-MRS) and/or phosphorus MRS (³¹P-MRS)
• in defined subgroups: exercise testing using an MRI-compatible bicycle ergometer during the CMR

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
•	ability to provide informed consent
•	Clinical indication for cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR)
•	Ability to understand and comply with the instructions provided by the MRI staff
Exclusion criteria:
•	Absence of written informed consent for study participation
